subject: general
question: Which was the first Act passed by the British government to control and regulate the affairs of the East India Company in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Regulating Act of 1773**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Regulating Act of 1773** was the first Act passed by the British government to control and regulate the affairs of the East India Company in India.
 
• The Act aimed to address the administrative and financial disorders of the Company in India and marked the beginning of British parliamentary control over the Company.
 
• It established the position of Governor-General of Bengal and created an executive council of four members to assist him.
 
• The Act also laid the foundation for a centralized administration in India.
 
• It mandated the Supreme Court of Judicature at Fort William in Calcutta to administer justice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Regulating Act was a significant step towards the establishment of British rule in India, leading to subsequent reforms and control measures by the British Parliament.
 
• Other notable Acts that followed include the Pitt's India Act of 1784, which further increased the British government's control over the East India Company.
 
• The Act of 1858 marked the end of Company rule and the beginning of direct control of India by the British Crown, following the Indian Rebellion of 1857.
 
• The Charter Acts and Government of India Acts were subsequent legislative measures that shaped the administrative structure of British India.
